name: TherapyDen
one_liner: Inclusive therapist directory focused on LGBTQ+ affirming and social justice-oriented providers. Free basic listing, $15/month for premium.
short_description: TherapyDen is a therapist directory emphasizing diversity and social justice. Helps clients find LGBTQ+ affirming therapists and providers serving marginalized communities.
long_description: TherapyDen is a therapist directory built with a focus on inclusivity and social justice. The platform helps clients find therapists who are affirming of LGBTQ+ identities, work with BIPOC communities, and approach therapy from a social justice lens. Provider profiles highlight specialties, identities, and therapeutic approaches. TherapyDen offers a free basic listing with paid premium options for enhanced visibility. The directory has become a go-to resource for clients seeking therapists who understand intersectional experiences and marginalized identities.

pricing.notes: Most affordable directory option with free tier.

not_for: Those seeking broad mainstream exposure (smaller than PT)
